must_keep: Preserve exact image_1 -> image_2 -> image_3 -> image_4 keyframe order
Fixed double-circular binocular mask over the whole 15s video; mask may never drift, deform, shake or reframe
Only content inside the circular lenses may move
Open blurred and hand-held, then quick rack-focus/push into sharp image_1
Between keyframes: telescope whip/scan transition with motion blur, optical smear, light streaks and exposure flicker; cut at maximum blur then quickly stabilize and refocus
image_1: preserve bus shelter, MINIMAX awning lettering, cast MINIMAX shadow, core composition
image_2: preserve pale facade and draped cloth; cloth moves with restrained wind and the vertical MINIMAX lettering stays readable
image_3: preserve person identity, hair, beige tailoring and red shoulder bag while performing a natural fashion-passerby walk, turn and arm swing
image_4: preserve person identity, red-framed sunglasses and red garment; execute a subtle chin raise rather than adding an unseen hand

Red caption type loads with focus: starts mildly defocused near 0.3 opacity, resolves within 0.3-0.5s, may micro-slide or breathe letter-spacing, never rotates/bounces/fly-large, exits by fade or motion blur before transitions
Wes Anderson-like voyeuristic 35mm look: fine grain, soft highlight bloom, restrained color grade, red used as selective accent
No new people, vehicles, buildings or logos
Keep MINIMAX/source-depicted wordmarks exactly as in their reference without inventing new spelling variants

shots.start_state: Inside the fixed lens mask, image_1 content appears heavily defocused and slightly hand-held; the mask itself remains locked.
shots.action: Quick push/rack-focus brings the bus shelter, MINIMAX awning and cast shadow into sharp focus; red field-note captions load and then clear; a telescope whip-scan builds motion blur, smear, streaks and exposure flicker until maximum blur at the cut.
shots.end_state: image_1 content is at its greatest smear and is cut on that maximum-blur moment; mask has not moved.
shots.sound_cues: Soft outdoor air, faint optical focus-ring tick, rising optical smear that cuts at the transition.
shots.audience_gain: Establishes the MINIMAX street-shelter scene and the peek-through-telescope focus ritual.

shots.start_state: Incoming maximum-blur smear inherited from Shot 1 is still moving inside the mask.
shots.action: The smear stabilizes and refocuses into image_2; the pale facade and white draped cloth become sharp; restrained wind animates the cloth while vertical MINIMAX lettering remains readable; red field-note captions load then clear; a second whip-scan reaches maximum blur at the cut.
shots.end_state: image_2 composition and MINIMAX cloth lettering are readable, then dissolve into maximum smear at 8.6s; mask fixed.
shots.sound_cues: Wind rises with cloth movement, soft cloth rustle and crease sounds, rustling stops before the scan; scan smear cuts at transition.
shots.audience_gain: Reveals cloth as the MINIMAX fabric signal while preserving readable typography on moving material.

shots.start_state: Incoming maximum-blur smear starts Shot 3 inside the fixed mask.
shots.action: The smear quickly stabilizes into image_3; the person with beige tailoring and red shoulder bag moves like a candidly captured passerby: relaxed steps, natural arm swings, and a smooth partial turn of head and torso; red captions load and clear; final whip-scan builds until the cut at maximum blur.
shots.end_state: The passerby has completed a natural partial turn and paused in a different but source-consistent orientation; image_3 content then smears to the cut; mask fixed.
shots.sound_cues: Footsteps on concrete occur only for actual steps and stop at the pause; fabric swish accompanies arm swing.
shots.audience_gain: Shows the person as a natural fashion passerby without losing identity or wardrobe.

shots.start_state: Incoming maximum-blur smear starts the final shot inside the fixed mask.
shots.action: The smear stabilizes into image_4; the person with red-framed sunglasses and red garment performs a subtle chin raise while holding a cool, relaxed fashion-campaign attitude; red captions load and remain sharp through the ending.
shots.end_state: Final close-up pose and red captions hold in focus until 15.000s; no further cut; mask fixed.
shots.sound_cues: No contact sound; only low air tone under the music during the final hold.
shots.audience_gain: Resolves on the cool reflective portrait and the final MINIMAX caption beat.
